about: Known-good and known-bad work for testing the judge before a round (the baseline experiment's round 4, item D). Each case is self-contained: the item's criteria, what its branch changes and the files HQ's checks read at its head, the verdict a right judge gives, and why. features/the-judge-is-tested.feature runs every case through HQ for judgment delivery and for what HQ's rules find; a model judge (an HQ reviewer, or the round's judge) is tested for judgment correctness by giving it each case and comparing its verdict with `verdict`.

cases.name: every default in the README
cases.why: The README names both defaults with their values.
criteria: roles/media/README.md lists every variable in the role's defaults/main.yml with its default

cases.name: a default with the wrong value
cases.why: media_port is 8096 in the defaults; the README says 8080.
criteria: roles/media/README.md lists every variable in the role's defaults/main.yml with its default

cases.name: the owner's own values touched
cases.why: The branch changes group_vars/all.yml, which is never to be touched.
criteria: roles/media/tasks/main.yml names its image by a release tag, not latest

cases.name: a CI run no push can give
cases.why: The criterion asks for a CI run on the branch, and the only workflow runs on a push to main and develop alone.
criteria: A CI run on the branch passes
workflows:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
